content.text: The cause is a typo in `_VALS`: the 900 entry is `"DCCCC"` instead of `"CM"`. That makes `_TABLE` map no `CM`-containing numeral, so `from_roman` rejects every numeral with a 900 component. I'll fix that one entry.

content.text: I changed one line in `solution/core.py`: the 900 entry in `_VALS` was `"DCCCC"` and is now `"CM"`. That error meant `_TABLE` never contained the numeral `CM` or any numeral built from it, so `from_roman` rejected valid inputs like `CM`, `MCMXCIV`, and most of 1 to 3999. The visible suite now passes (3 passed). I did not touch anything under `tests/`, add dependencies, or change the `from_roman` API.
